description: This file contains unit tests for the AnyCodable data structure, focusing on its encoding to JSON and preservation of boolean values. It verifies proper JSON encoding and decoding behavior, including handling of NSNumber booleans and JSON serialization/deserialization within a test framework.

classes.name: AnyCodableTests
classes.description: A test suite for verifying JSON encoding and decoding behavior of the AnyCodable structure.

methods.name: encodesNSNumberBooleansAsJSONBooleans
methods.description: Tests that NSNumber boolean values are correctly encoded as JSON booleans.

methods.name: preservesBooleanLiteralsFromJSONSerializationBridge
methods.description: Checks that JSON serialization and deserialization preserve boolean literals within the AnyCodable structure.
